title: Street Brawl
core_verb: Strike enemies to reduce their health to zero while advancing toward the stage boss.
fantasy: A lone street fighter battles through an urban side-scrolling stage occupied by a gang and its boss.
fail_state: The player is defeated when player health reaches zero.
win_state: Defeat the stage boss by reducing boss health to zero after clearing 8 regular enemies.

interaction_tags.meaning: Regular hostile fighter; attacks reduce player health and its health must reach zero to clear the stage path.
Collectible food item that restores 30 player health, up to the maximum.
Final hostile fighter; reducing its health to zero triggers victory.

notes: The cooperative campaign is reduced to one single-player stage containing 8 regular enemies followed by 1 boss.

scene.description: A grimy urban back alley at dusk, dumpsters and chain-link fences narrowing the path, neon signs flickering from storefronts above. Gang clusters block the way forward, health pickups sit between them, and a boss area waits at the end. Trash bags, cardboard boxes, fire hydrants and puddles reflecting orange street light crowd the sides, dense enough that every fight happens in a confined space.
